tagline: A strategic partner to leading independent investment firms globally
hero_kpi_rationale: AUM is the primary revenue and value driver in AMG's business model, reflecting the ability to attract and retain capital at its independent Affiliates

kpis.name: Assets under management
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed by AMG's affiliated companies.
kpis.description: Assets under management increased 15% in 2025, reaching $813.3 billion driven by the addition of new Affiliates and market performance gains.
kpis.signal: Growth of 15% in 2025 driven by new affiliate partnerships and market performance gains

kpis.name: Average assets under management
kpis.explanation: Average assets under management for the year, used to calculate management fee revenues.
kpis.description: Average AUM grew 9% in 2025, reflecting positive net accumulation and inflows from new Affiliates.
kpis.signal: Sustained average AUM growth at 9%, a key driver of recurring revenue streams

kpis.name: Total fees
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated from management fees collected on assets under management.
kpis.description: Total fees reached $6.17 billion in 2025, driven by AUM growth and high-margin products.
kpis.signal: Fee growth of 18% outpaces AUM growth of 15%, indicating favorable mix shift and pricing

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenues and direct costs, as a percentage of revenues.
kpis.description: Gross margin was 69.9% in 2025, improving 150 basis points, supported by better absorption of fixed costs.
kpis.signal: Gross margin expansion of 150 basis points reflects operating leverage and cost efficiency

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit as a percentage of total revenues.
kpis.description: Operating margin reached 32.1% in 2025, improving 200 basis points, reflecting rigorous management of general and administrative expenses.
kpis.signal: Operating margin improvement of 200 basis points demonstrates disciplined expense management

kpis.name: R&D expenses (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development spending as a percentage of revenues.
kpis.description: AMG dedicated 4.2% of revenues to innovation and product development, primarily through its Affiliates.
kpis.signal: Stable R&D intensity at 4.2% of revenues reflects measured innovation approach for asset management

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or digital assets to support growth.
kpis.description: CAPEX was $185.3 million in 2025, up 12%, supported by investments in cybersecurity and digital platforms.
kpis.signal: Capex growth of 12% supports technology and cybersecurity infrastructure expansion

kpis.name: Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees within the AMG group.
kpis.description: AMG had 1,420 employees at year-end 2025, up 5%, aligned with strengthening support teams for Affiliates.
kpis.signal: Headcount growth of 5% supports geographic expansion and affiliate support capabilities

kpis.name: Assets under management
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed by AMG's affiliated companies.
kpis.description: Assets under management increased 15% in 2025, reaching $813.3 billion driven by the addition of new Affiliates and market performance gains.
kpis.signal: Growth of 15% in 2025 driven by new affiliate partnerships and market performance

kpis.name: Total fees
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated from management fees collected on assets under management.
kpis.description: Total fees reached $6.17 billion in 2025, driven by AUM growth and high-margin products.
kpis.signal: Fee growth of 18% outpaces AUM growth, driven by favorable product mix and pricing

risks.title: Critical cybersecurity threats
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, with a dedicated governance program overseen by the CIO and security committee, which reports to the Board. The language emphasizes reasonably foreseeable threats and the need for detection, response, and notification mechanisms. Cybersecurity is a heavily weighted category in the Financials sector.

ai_positioning.summary: AMG does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
